trigger: If dam_secret_told=authority: Avila's Guard arrives with conditions.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Headlights up the access road. Two Humvees. Avila steps out like she owns the road.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: You did it. Good. Now the plant is under the Recovery Authority. Feeders go where my list says.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: Lady, the plant goes where the steam says. I've been here twenty-two years.

choices.text: Work with us, Captain. Not over us.
Walk away. This isn't your call.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: ...I'll leave four guards. Not as a threat. As insurance.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Thank you. That's how we survive. Somebody has to own it.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: I can't make you. Yet. Remember I asked nicely.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The Humvees idle. Somebody has to start the plant now.
